    available = {
        exists = owner
        bca_has_minerals_to_build = yes
        has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_enabled
        NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_disable_ratling_scavenger }
    }

    emergency = yes
    category = "planet_automation_job_management"

    job_changes = {
        ratling_scavenger_inc_g3200 = {
            available = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_ratling_scavenger_g3200
            }
            job = ratling_scavenger
            amount = 3200

            available = {
